items.title: Billy Bauer interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, March 22, 1998
items.q: In the Metronome All Stars with Diz and Miles and Charlie Parker... If Charlie called me up for his record date. And within a couple of weeks I’m sitting there... 'This is the Bird.'

ctx.x: Well you said an interesting thing before, they ask you well how did you do it, and you say well don’t do what I did. But let’s talk about what you did.

All right. Well the reason I give them, they say well you know like you say listen to Lester or Charlie or one of them guys. They says but that would be imitating. I says you can never imitate the same. Because they says what do you mean, we could play it. I says you see that? What am I showing you?
